prompt:
Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: production native transparent injured-evacuee sprite atlas for Chinese painterly isometric RTS Liangshan Heroes.
Create a NEW square transparent RGBA atlas with EXACTLY SIXTEEN separate full-body poses in a REGULAR 4 ROW x 4 COLUMN grid. ONE identified man repeated, no other people.
Input images are existing identity/clothing/style references only. Bound-reference ropes MUST be removed; walking-reference weapons and bags MUST be removed. This is an ALIVE RESCUED NONCOMBAT WOUNDED FOOT EVACUEE. Both wrists free, EMPTY hands; no weapon, sheath, bag, flag, rope, mount, blood or corpse. Slight tired forward lean and guarded abdomen with one empty hand; the other free arm balances gently. No added injury props or arbitrary costume changes.
ROW 1: every pose faces SE, FRONT three-quarter DOWN-RIGHT. ROW 2: every pose faces SW, FRONT three-quarter DOWN-LEFT. ROW 3: every pose faces NE, REAR three-quarter UP-RIGHT. ROW 4: every pose faces NW, REAR three-quarter UP-LEFT. Whole torso/feet point that way. Independently DRAW opposite views, never pixel mirror.
In EVERY ROW, COLUMN 1 = quiet tired STATIONARY IDLE, feet fairly close; COLUMN 2 = short careful limping step LEFT FOOT FORWARD/right back; COLUMN 3 = passing transition, legs moving close under body; COLUMN 4 = alternate short careful step RIGHT FOOT FORWARD/left back. Clearly distinct lower-leg/foot phases in columns2/3/4, consistent camera, face, costume, body height and foot-ground baseline. Calm slow walking, NOT running or fighting. Rear poses show back naturally, no front-facing pasted head.
Full body contained inside EACH cell, centered with at least 25px genuinely empty transparent padding on ALL four cell edges. Figure approx65% cell height. Wide clean transparent gutters on every grid boundary, no touching neighbors. Equal body height across16 poses, stable foot baseline. Crisp hand-painted historic RTS silhouette readable at60-85px display height, restrained cloth folds, no chibi/photographic style. GENUINE alpha transparency, no checkerboard/black floor/cast shadow/text/labels/grid/border. Native square max1536 pixels, ideally1254 or1024. No baked background. Preserve identity:
Slim Chinese man, alert eyes, black wrapped headcloth and black nose/mouth mask, charcoal cross-over cloth tunic and trousers, dark shin wraps and cloth boots. NO sack, backpack or weapon. Keep mask and narrow unarmored body.
scope: Native atlas candidate; source review, independent reconstruction and original rescue/runtime visuals required before acceptance.
